caption: The model's Eval PPL under different sparsity settings applied to Attention and FFN components at varying ratios.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the Eval PPL. of four different model configurations (Transformer, Only MoHD FFN, Only MoHD ATTN, and MoHD ATTN + MLP) evaluated across varying activated parameter ratios. The x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" and uses a linear scale that decreases from left to right, starting at 100 and ending at 25, with tick marks regularly spaced at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL." and employs a linear scale with numeric tick marks ranging from 11.5 to 14.0 at intervals of 0.5. The "Transformer" configuration is represented by a red dashed line with no markers, maintaining a constant steady value of approximately 11.6 across the entire x-axis. The "Only MoHD FFN" configuration, shown as a grey solid line with square markers, begins at approximately 11.45 at an x-axis value of 100, decreases gradually to a low of roughly 11.3 at an x-axis value of 50, and then rises to approximately 11.8 at an x-axis value of 25. The "Only MoHD ATTN" configuration is depicted by a dark blue solid line with circle markers; it starts around 11.45 at an x-axis value of 100, rises slightly to roughly 11.6 at 75, increases more sharply to approximately 12.25 at 50, and ends at a peak of roughly 14.3 at an x-axis value of 25. Finally, the "MoHD ATTN + MLP" configuration is represented by a light blue solid line with cross ('x') markers, starting at approximately 11.45 at an x-axis value of 100, climbing steadily to roughly 12.05 at 50, and concluding at approximately 13.2 at an x-axis value of 25.
